cues: Every PHP program that uses a database follows the same five steps.
Connect, with the host, user, password and database name.
Fetch the rows, usually in a while loop, because fetch returns false when the rows run out.
text: Every PHP program that uses a database follows the same five steps. Connect, with the host, user, password and database name. Check the connection. Send a query. Fetch the rows, usually in a while loop, because fetch returns false when the rows run out. And close the connection.
